legalName.label: Legal name
legalName.help: The registered name used on contracts, invoices and tax forms.

startPage.label: Start page
startPage.help: The page Atlas opens after sign-in.

fiscalYearStart.label: Fiscal year starts in month
fiscalYearStart.help: Enter a month number from 1 (January) to 12 (December).

baseCurrency.label: Base currency
baseCurrency.help: Budgets, reports and spend limits use this currency unless a project sets another.

invoicePrefix.label: Invoice number prefix
invoicePrefix.help: Up to 12 characters placed before each new invoice number, for example INV-.

mfaPolicy.label: Multi-factor authentication
mfaPolicy.help: Who must use a second factor. Anyone it applies to sets one up, or verifies the one they have, before opening the organization.

sessionHours.label: Session length in hours
sessionHours.help: How long a sign-in lasts before the person signs in again, from 1 to 720 hours.

idleTimeout.label: Idle timeout in minutes
idleTimeout.help: Sign out after this many minutes without activity, from 5 to 1,440.

ipAllowlist.label: Enforce the IP allow-list
ipAllowlist.help: When on, Atlas and the API accept requests only from the allowed networks listed below. List at least one network first.

autoJoin.label: Automatic join
autoJoin.help: People who confirm an address at a verified domain join with that domain's default role.

removeUnreviewed.label: Remove unreviewed access
removeUnreviewed.help: Remove roles a manager has not confirmed by the end of the grace period.

reviewGraceDays.label: Review grace period in days
reviewGraceDays.help: Days after a quarterly review opens before unreviewed access is flagged.

density.label: Density
density.help: How much space lists and tables use.

numberPadding.label: Number padding
numberPadding.help: Digits in each document number, from 1 to 10. Four gives 0042. The invoice prefix and this padding are the numbers you can customize; record keys like NWS-42 are fixed.

rounding.label: Punch rounding
rounding.help: Round clock-in and clock-out times to this many minutes.

photoOnPunch.label: Photo on punch
photoOnPunch.help: Ask kiosks for a photo at every clock-in and clock-out.

geofenceRequired.label: Require the geofence
geofenceRequired.help: Refuse phone and web clock-ins outside the project's geofence. Kiosks are exempt.

kioskEnabled.label: Kiosk clock-in
kioskEnabled.help: Let crew clock in on a shared kiosk device with a PIN.

openShiftClaiming.label: Open shift claiming
openShiftClaiming.help: How crew claim open shifts: the first to claim gets it, a supervisor approves, or the most senior claimant gets it.

allowSwaps.label: Allow shift swaps
allowSwaps.help: Crew may offer their shifts to each other.

swapApproval.label: Swaps need approval
swapApproval.help: A supervisor approves each swap before it takes effect. When off, the person offered the shift accepts it.

payPeriod.label: Pay period
payPeriod.help: How often payroll runs. New pay periods follow it.

weekStart.label: Week starts on
weekStart.help: The first day of the week on calendars and timesheets.

marketplaceVisibility.label: Marketplace visibility
marketplaceVisibility.help: Who can find your opportunities in the Gateway marketplace: everyone, people who worked with you, or only pools and invitees.

ratingsEnabled.label: Prompt members to rate parties
ratingsEnabled.help: Members see completed engagements waiting for their rating, and Rate the party as the next step. Ratings are always on: turning prompts off never hides or removes a rating, and rated parties and marketplace viewers see the same ratings either way. Moderation follows policy only (abuse, personal data), whatever the score.

messageRetention.label: Message retention in days
messageRetention.help: Delete messages older than this many days, from 30 to 3,650. A legal hold keeps them.

autoTranslate.label: Translate messages
autoTranslate.help: Offer a translation of messages written in another language.

supportEmail.label: Internal support email
supportEmail.help: Where members send questions about how your organization works. Shown in the help panel.

supportHours.label: Support hours
supportHours.help: Shown in the help panel, for example Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern.

helpLink.label: Custom help link
helpLink.help: A page with your own guides, shown in the help panel.

language.label: Language
language.help: The language of menus, emails and documents.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.help: Times are shown and entered in this zone.

dateFormat.label: Date format
dateFormat.help: Follow the language, or use year-month-day everywhere.

units.label: Units
units.help: Units for distances, weights and areas.

persona.label: Persona
persona.help: Opens the sidebar groups this work needs in this organization.

highContrast.label: High contrast
highContrast.help: Stronger borders and text for easier reading.

reducedMotion.label: Motion
reducedMotion.help: Follow your device, or always reduce animation.

captions.label: Captions
captions.help: Show captions on video and voice notes.

oooEnabled.label: Out of office
oooEnabled.help: Tell people you are away and send your approvals to your delegate.

oooReply.label: Automatic reply
oooReply.help: Sent once to each person who messages you while you are away.

shortcutsEnabled.label: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcutsEnabled.help: Single-key shortcuts such as J, K and ? on desktop.

messageTranslation.label: Translate chat messages
messageTranslation.help: Members can read a chat message in their own language. Messages are sent to Google Cloud Translation, a subprocessor, and each translation is kept for the conversation. Off by default.

brand.title: Brand
brand.displayNameHelp: Shown instead of the organization name on branded pages. Leave empty to use the organization name.
brand.accentHelp: A six-digit hex color, for example #5B63E8.
brand.invalidColor: Enter a six-digit hex color, for example #5B63E8.
brand.passes: Passes WCAG 2.2 AA in every theme.
brand.fails: Fails WCAG 2.2 AA in {count, plural, one {# pair} other {# pairs}}. Choose a darker or more saturated accent.
brand.neutralTintHelp: Optional. A six-digit hex color that tints grays.
brand.senderNameHelp: The name people see on emails sent for your organization.
brand.legalEntityHelp: Named on purchase orders, invoices and other generated documents.
brand.suppressHelp: Removes the platform credit from branded pages, emails and documents.
brand.suppressNeedsPlan: Available on Pro and above. Compare plans in Billing and Plan.
brand.assetNone: No file yet. The platform mark is used.
brand.assetHelp: PNG, WebP or ICO, up to 2 MB. Logos at least 256 pixels wide.
brand.assetScanning: Being checked for viruses. It replaces the current mark once the check passes.

domains.title: Domains
domains.none: No domains yet. Add one below.
domains.txt: Add a DNS TXT record with the value {token}. Verification runs automatically.
domains.needsPlan: Custom domains and email sending domains are on Pro and above. Compare plans in Billing and Plan.
domains.verifiedHelp: A verified domain earns the verified badge on your profile and can let people with that email address join automatically.

states.Failed: Verification failed. Check the TXT record.

modules.help: A module that is off leaves navigation, search and the command menu for everyone. Its records stay.

legal.title: Accepted terms
legal.none: No acceptances are recorded for this organization yet.

workspaces.none: No workspaces yet. Create one to override settings for it.

teams.none: No teams yet. Teams group members who work together.

descriptions.teams: Teams group members who share work. Each team lists its members.
descriptions.workspaces: Workspaces divide the org by office or venue group. Override settings for each one here.
descriptions.accessReviews: Each quarter, managers confirm or remove every member's role. Set how unreviewed access is handled.

legalEntities.title: Legal entities
legalEntities.description: The companies your organization trades as. The primary entity appears on invoices, purchase orders and other documents.
legalEntities.none: No legal entities yet. Add the company that signs your contracts.
legalEntities.countryHelp: Two letters, like US or GB.
legalEntities.taxIdentifierHelp: EIN, VAT or GST number. Stored encrypted; only the last four are shown.

network.title: Allowed networks
network.description: When the allow-list is on, Atlas and the API accept requests only from these networks.
network.notInPlan: The IP allow-list is part of the Team and Enterprise plans.
network.notEnforced: The allow-list is off, so every network can reach your organization.

network.cidrHelp: One address, or a range like 203.0.113.0/24.
network.label: Label

breakGlass.title: Emergency access
breakGlass.description: An Owner can take full access for one hour with a second factor and a written reason. Every Owner and Admin is notified and it is recorded in the audit log.
breakGlass.reason: Why do you need emergency access?
breakGlass.reasonHelp: At least 20 characters. Owners and Admins see this reason.
breakGlass.none: No one has taken emergency access.

reviews.title: Access review
reviews.description: Confirm or remove each member's roles. Access left unreviewed is flagged after the grace period, and removed if the review says so.
reviews.name: Review name
reviews.autoRemove: Remove access still unreviewed after the grace period
reviews.autoRemoveOn: Unreviewed access is removed after the grace period.
reviews.autoRemoveOff: Unreviewed access is flagged after the grace period.

reviews.subject: {role} role of {person}

blocks.title: Blocked people and organizations
blocks.description: Blocking hides your profile from them and theirs from you. Shared work, memberships and engagements continue.
blocks.handleHelp: The part after /u/ or /c/ in the profile address.

projectRoles.title: Additional project roles
projectRoles.lead: A member can hold several roles on this project. Their capabilities are the union of every role.
projectRoles.none: No member holds more than one role on this project.
projectRoles.addLabel: Give a member another project role

shares.title: Shared with partner organizations
shares.lead: Partner members see this project's name, dates and shared scope, never budgets or internal notes, and act with the role you choose. Both organizations' audit logs record the share.
shares.noPartners: Add an organization you work with as a vendor or client to share with it.
shares.roleHelp: Every member of the partner organization holds this role on the project.

sharedWithUs.title: Shared with your organization
sharedWithUs.entry: Shared by {owner} · Your members act as {role}

notifications.urgent: Urgent: never waits for the email digest.
notifications.loadFailed: Notification settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

errors.notification_category_mandatory: Your organization made this category mandatory on that channel, so it stays on.
errors.time_zone_unknown: Choose a time zone from the list.
errors.unexpected: The settings were not saved. Try again.
errors.sms_phone_unverified: Verify a phone number on your account before turning on texts.

fieldErrors.quietPair: Set both the start and the end of quiet hours, or neither.
fieldErrors.quietSame: Quiet hours end at a different time than they start.

mine.matrixDescription: Choose how each kind of notification reaches you. Until you choose, your organization's defaults apply.
mine.smsNote: Texts go only to a verified phone number you agreed to receive texts on. Reply STOP to any text to stop them.
mine.quietDescription: During quiet hours, push notifications wait until the end and texts arrive together as one message. Texts also wait between 21:00 and 08:00 in your time zone unless you set your own quiet hours. Safety alerts and changes to a shift starting within 12 hours always arrive at once.
mine.digestHelp: Gathers email that is not urgent into one message.
mine.smsNoPhone: Add and verify a phone number on your account to receive texts.
mine.smsConsent: Text me notifications from this organization at {phone}. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to stop or HELP for help.

org.matrixDescription: What members receive until they choose for themselves. Mark a category mandatory to keep its checked channels on for everyone.
org.mandatoryHelp: Mandatory categories stay on for every channel checked here. Texts still need each member's consent, and STOP still stops them.
org.readOnly: You can see the defaults. Changing them needs the notification settings permission.

mentions.label: Mentions
mentions.help: Someone mentions you in a comment or message.

assignments.label: Assignments
assignments.help: Work, training or a help request is assigned to you.

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.help: Requests waiting for your decision, and decisions on your requests.

comments.label: Comments
comments.help: New comments on records you follow.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.help: Shifts assigned or changed, and event invitations.

finance.label: Invoices and payments
finance.help: Invoices approved, received, scheduled and paid.

safety.label: Safety
safety.help: Incidents, occupancy thresholds and weather alerts.

account.label: Account and billing
account.help: Security changes, break-glass access and payment problems.

imports.label: Imports and exports
imports.help: Imports that finished and exports ready to download.

messages.label: Messages
messages.help: New chat messages to you or your groups.

notInEffect: Saved, but not in effect yet.
